user.title: Pacific Power solar credits
user.description: Track the remaining banked kWh on your statement. Choose how to read bills.

reconfigure.title: Update solar credits
reconfigure.description: Import a new statement, or sign in for automatic checks. Importing a PDF switches automatic checks off.

bill.title: Import bill PDF
bill.description: Upload a downloaded Pacific Power statement. Only the credit balance, statement date, expiry billing month and an account fingerprint are retained. The PDF is deleted after reading. Import a new PDF when a new bill arrives.

portal.title: Sign in to Pacific Power
portal.description: Check for new statements every 12 hours. Your login is stored on the Home Assistant volume. Automatic sign-in currently supports username and password; if your account requires a verification code, use Import bill PDF and keep verification enabled.

error.invalid_bill: The PDF must be a Pacific Power bill with an unambiguous excess-power credit note, billing date, and account number. A missing note is not treated as zero.
error.wrong_account: This bill belongs to a different account. Add it as a separate integration.
error.older_bill: This bill is older than the recorded statement. Import a newer bill.
error.invalid_auth: Pacific Power sign-in failed or requires an unsupported verification step. Check your login, or use Import bill PDF while keeping account verification enabled.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to read the latest Pacific Power statement. Try again later or import its PDF.
error.no_accounts: No metered Pacific Power account was found for this login.
error.statement_unavailable: Signed in to Pacific Power, but could not read the latest statement. The Home Assistant log now identifies the failed step. Try again later or import the bill PDF.

abort.already_configured: This account is already configured. Use Reconfigure to import a newer bill.
